Class RoutedTransportEngine

java.lang.Object
org.ngengine.nostr4j.rtc.routing.RoutedTransportEngine
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, InternalRoutedTransport
public final class RoutedTransportEngine extends Object implements InternalRoutedTransport, Closeable
Integrated dc4 routed transport core. It owns route setup/circuit state and receives only direct-neighbor traffic from its room adapter.
